voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Qumran, nineteen fifty-two. In a cave by the Dead Sea, archaeologists found a scroll made of copper.
It is a list. Sixty-four hiding places, and the treasure said to lie at nearly all of them.
It was sawn into strips to be read. By some estimates, the total runs to tons.
In the early nineteen-sixties, an expedition dug at some of the sites. It found nothing. No treasure has ever been found.
Temple treasure hidden from Rome, a legend, or a hoax? Scholars still disagree.
